notes.title: I'm a King is available for purchase!
notes.content:
For a while, after the release, I'm a King was not available for purchase. I apologize for this technical problem I made. In this regard, as my apology, you can purchase I'm a King with a 10% discount

[b]Enjoy your game, Your Highness![/b]

notes.title: Improving the game
notes.content: This is a brand new product! I hope you will forgive me for changing during the publication and will be pleased with what I have prepared for you!
